notes: S2-FIX5 (decision 2026-11-16 #9; §5.3): the only declaration of a human key (cosigned by the keyset root human-1) fails the §14.1 structural group — its body has no key_type (E_KIND_BODY_SCHEMA; re-signed, so both of its equations hold against the material it states for its own key). A declaration supplies verification material only when it passes the structural group and its other signatures pass, so a note signed by that key at T2 has no material: unverifiable E_KEY_UNKNOWN, N_KEY_UNDECLARED, and no TOFU.
